reply: Thank you for telling us that personal information on your credit report does not belong to you. We understand why you want it corrected quickly. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Identity errors such as a wrong name, address or Social Security number are a common problem, so please dispute each detail and include copies of your ID and proof of address. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us that fraudulent accounts on your credit report are hurting your ability to get credit. We understand how frustrating this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please dispute each account with the credit reporting companies, and if this is identity theft, report it through the federal identity theft website and include the report with your disputes. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a late payment on your consumer report is incorrect because you have always paid on time. We understand why you want it updated. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please send your dispute with proof of the payment date for the month in question. If the result does not resolve it, you can request a reinvestigation. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that two accounts on your credit report contain information you believe is incorrect. We understand you want them verified. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please explain what is wrong with each account, such as the balance or status, and include any statements that show the correct details. Keep copies of your dispute. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us that several accounts you did not open appear on your credit report while you are buying your retirement home. We understand the urgency. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please report the identity theft through the federal identity theft website and send that report with your disputes to each credit reporting company. Review your reports again afterwards. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us that inquiries appear on your credit report that you did not authorize. We understand your concern for your privacy. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Credit reports can only be shared with companies that have a permissible purpose, such as a credit application. Please list each inquiry you do not recognize and dispute it in writing. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us that an inquiry appears on your credit report from a creditor you have never done business with. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please dispute the inquiry with the credit reporting company that shows it, and keep checking your report for other unfamiliar names, since some lenders report under a different name. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that an inquiry from an application you did not make is still on two of your credit reports, even though the application was cancelled and removal was requested. We understand your frustration after three months. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please send a written dispute to each credit reporting company with the creditor's cancellation confirmation. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you believe a debt being collected is too old to be collected, and that you are concerned about changes to its reporting dates. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please ask in writing for the validation details of the debt, including the dates it was opened and became delinquent, and keep copies of your letters. Reporting time limits are separate from collection time limits. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us that some information on your credit report is incorrect and has not been validated. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please explain for each account what is wrong and include supporting documents. If a company finds it supplied wrong information, it must notify every credit reporting company it sent it to. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for sharing your concerns about the accuracy and completeness of the information on your report. We understand you want it checked against reporting standards. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please identify each item and describe what is incomplete or wrong, and ask for a description of how it was verified. You can request a reinvestigation if you disagree. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your attempts to correct inaccurate reporting have not succeeded and that you want to opt out of several reporting companies. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. You can opt out of prescreened credit offers through the official opt-out service, and you can keep disputing specific inaccurate items in writing. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your credit reports show different balances for the same accounts while you are shopping for a car. We understand the timing matters. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please dispute each balance that is wrong, showing the correct figure, and include your attached reports and statements. If you disagree with the result, you can request a reinvestigation. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us that you could not get your free credit report online and were asked to send a request by mail. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the consumer services team. You can request your free reports through the official annual credit report website, by phone or by mail, and checking your own report does not affect your score. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that some accounts on your credit report appear to be reported incorrectly. We understand why you want them reviewed. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please describe for each account what is wrong, such as the balance, dates or status, and include any records you have. Checking for common errors can help focus your dispute. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that two accounts show different payment histories at each of the three credit bureaus, despite your letters. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please dispute the payment history directly with the companies that supply it as well, since they must notify every bureau if their information was wrong. Keep copies of every letter. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you have asked many times for records that are not yours to be removed after identity theft. We are sorry you feel no one is listening. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please report the theft through the federal identity theft website and send that report with a list of each item to each credit reporting company. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a hard inquiry was added when you opened a checking and savings account, and that you were not told a credit check would be run. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the account services team, including what was disclosed when you opened the accounts. Please ask for copies of the documents you signed and keep a note of your call. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us that your records contain inaccurate information and that you are worried someone else may be using your credit profile. We understand how upsetting this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please list the inaccurate items, including any personal details or accounts you do not recognize, and dispute them with supporting documents. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that inaccuracies in your credit reports are causing confusion with lenders when you apply for credit. We understand the effect this has. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please identify each inaccurate item and send a dispute with supporting documents. If the company that supplied it finds it was wrong, it must tell every credit reporting company. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you asked for documentation of permissible purpose and a description of the reinvestigation procedure, and that you have not received a response. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please keep copies of your letters and proof of the dates they were received, and resend your request for the reinvestigation description in writing. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us that two accounts on your credit report are reported in error. We understand you want them reviewed and corrected. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please explain what is incorrect about each account, such as its balance or status, and include any statements or receipts that support your dispute. Keep copies of everything you send. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a mortgage account and bankruptcy records on your report are shown with statuses you believe are inaccurate. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please dispute each item with the credit reporting company, explain what is wrong, and include copies of any court or account records that show the correct status. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you want an account removed unless evidence is provided to show it is accurate. We understand your frustration with the response so far. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please identify the account and what you believe is inaccurate, and ask for a description of how it was verified. If you disagree with the result, you can request a reinvestigation. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us about credit inquiries on your report that you do not recognize. We understand your concern that they may be errors or fraud. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Hard inquiries usually come from credit applications, so please list each one you did not make and dispute it in writing, keeping copies of what you send. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us that an account on your credit report is incorrect and that you did not give permission for it to be reported. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please dispute the account with the credit reporting company and the company that supplied it, explain what is wrong and include supporting documents. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for sharing your concerns about the accounts listed in your complaint and your privacy. We understand you want only accurate information reported. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please explain for each account whether it is not yours, inaccurate or too old to report, and include any records that support this. You can request a reinvestigation if you disagree. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for asking that information resulting from identity theft be removed from your credit file. We understand the urgency. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please send an Identity Theft Report from the federal identity theft website, proof of your identity and a list of each item, and then check your reports to confirm they are blocked. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you disagree with the reinvestigation results for an account and want a description of how it was verified. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please send a written request for the description of the procedure used, quoting your report number, and explain which details you believe are inaccurate. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for sharing your documents and the victim determination letter supporting your request to block information resulting from trafficking. We understand how important this is for you. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please keep copies of your ID, utility bill and advocacy letter, and check your report after the review to confirm the items are blocked. You will receive an update once the review is complete.
